title: Wedding reception seating chart
goal: A guest can find their named seat and a server can trace open routes from the service entrance to every table without crossing the dance floor.

rubric.must: Four distinctly numbered round tables each show eight chairs, and every chair has a readable ordinary guest name.
A labeled head table has four individually named seats facing toward the dance floor.
A labeled dance floor is visible between the round-table groups and contains no tables or chairs.
Open walking routes connect the labeled service entrance to every table without passing through chairs or across the dance floor.
All chairs are inside the walls, with visible walking space behind them and between neighboring table groups.
Separate guest and service entrances show door leaves and swing arcs with no furniture in either swept area.
Exterior dimensions show a 16 m by 16 m room, and guest names, table labels and entrance labels are readable without overlapping one another.

ideal.notes: Drafted by Codex from the source and the rubric, without seeing the engine's own output. It preferred the svg: The SVG satisfies the seating, head-table, clearance, entrance, and dimension requirements, while the picture omits several required elements.
